facts.text: Colombia has both Caribbean and Pacific coastlines.
Bogotá is the capital, high in the Andes.
Its landscapes include Amazon rainforest and eastern plains.

culture.text: Cali is especially associated with salsa music and dance.

food.name: Sancocho
food.text: This substantial soup has many regional versions, including chicken and coastal fish preparations.
